o.text: Borrowed from Arabic غَرْبِيّ (ḡarbiyy). By surface analysis, qərb + -i.
From Proto-Turkic *kat-. Cognate with Turkish katmak, etc.
From Proto-Oghuz *čocuk (“piglet, child”), from Proto-Common Turkic *čōč-.
Calque of New Latin mammālis (“of or for the breasts”) or phono-semantic matching of New Latin mammālis. By surface analysis, məmə + -li.
